newsitem.title: USA: ICN, Hoffmann-La Roche extend pact.
newsitem.headline: ICN, Hoffmann-La Roche extend pact.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc said Tuesday that it has signed an agreement with F. Hoffmann- La Roche Ltd. (Roche) to extend its licensing agreement for an additional three years.

Under its agreement with Roche, ICN's Yugoslav subsidiary, ICN Yugoslavia, makes markets seven drugs and 23 over-the-counter products, including vitamins. In addition to Bactrim, the licensing agreement includes such leading Roche products as Rocephin, marketed under ICN Yugoslavia's own brand name, Longaceph, and Prilazid, Roche's new ACE Inhibitor.
The agreement between the Basel, Switzerland-based company and ICN Yugoslavia also provides that the contract be considered for renewal every three years hence forth.
